user.title: Set up LearnBuddy

data_description.timeout_minuten: After this time a question counts as unanswered (not as wrong).
data_description.ki_entity: Optional. This AI task entity checks vocabulary answers that are wrong locally for synonyms and typos, evaluates math answers that are no plain numbers, explains solutions and creates math tasks. No name or other personal data is sent.
data_description.auto_freigabe: Off: tasks created by the AI wait in the panel until you approve them. On: they are asked right away if their solution could be verified.

data.name: First name
data.notify_data: Additional data of the notify action

data_description.name: Used to address the child. It is never sent to an AI service.
data_description.notify_entity: Messenger entity that delivers questions to the child. Use either this or the legacy action.
data_description.notify_service: Name of a legacy notify action, for example notify.whatsapp.
data_description.notify_target: Recipients passed as target, for example a phone number or chat ID.
data_description.absender_kennung: Phone number or chat ID used to match incoming answers to this child.
data_description.werktag_von: Questions are only sent inside this time window.
data_description.muttersprache: Source language of the vocabulary. Foreign language subjects of this child are asked between this language and the foreign language. Changing it later only affects new subjects.
data_description.bild_aktion: Optional. Only needed if the messenger is not Telegram: actions that send an image, for tasks with a diagram. The variables bild_url (address valid for ten minutes), bild_pfad (file) and text (the task) are available.

fremdsprache.title: Foreign language
fremdsprache.description: Vocabulary is asked in both directions between {ausgangssprache} and the foreign language. The language cannot be changed later.

data_description.name: Optional. Without a name the subject is called like the language.
data_description.ki_entity: Optional. Overrides the global AI entity for this subject.

mathe.title: Mathematics
mathe.description: Math tasks have one short result. You can enter them, import them or let the AI create them from examples.

data_description.name: Optional. Without a name the subject is called Math.
data_description.ki_entity: Optional. Overrides the global AI entity for this subject.

sach.title: Knowledge subject
sach.description: For subjects like biology, geography or history. Questions have a model answer; the AI can create them from a photo of a textbook page and judges free answers.

data_description.ki_entity: Optional. Overrides the global AI entity for this subject. Without an AI only multiple-choice questions can be asked.

error.name_vorhanden: This child already has a subject with this name.

data_description.lektionen: Tasks of these lessons are asked. Leave empty to use all tasks of the subject. Lessons are created in the LearnBuddy panel.
data_description.intensivierung: The number of questions grows up to twice the value on the last day.
data_description.antwortfrist_minuten: Optional. After this time a question of this exam counts as unanswered. Empty: the general setting applies. If a task belongs to several running exams, the shortest time wins.
data_description.simulation_um: Optional. At this time the child automatically gets a simulation of this exam in the messenger: the sheet as an image, then the tasks one after the other, the result at the end. It is tried once.

senden_fehlgeschlagen.title: Messages to {name} cannot be delivered
senden_fehlgeschlagen.description: LearnBuddy could not send a message using `{ziel}`. Check that the messenger integration works and that the notify target of the child is correct. The issue disappears after the next successful message.

ki_gestoert.title: The AI of LearnBuddy does not work
ki_gestoert.description: The AI entity `{entity}` that is selected in LearnBuddy is missing or failed several times. Check that the AI integration works (account, credit, model) or select another entity in the options of LearnBuddy or of the subject. Until then answers are only judged locally and AI features are switched off. The issue disappears as soon as the AI works again.
